deadline.value: No Computer Science deadline is stated on the department or catalog page.

gre_general.value: The Kennedy College lists GRE only for Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences, so the Computer Science Ph.D. does not require it.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are only required for the following programs: | Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences.

supervisor.value: The pages name the letters of recommendation but do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The Computer Science pages do not describe funding for PhD students.

entry_route.value: A master's in computer science is needed for the PhD, but students without one can enter the combined MS/PhD route.
entry_route.quote: Admission into the Doctor of Philosophy degree program requires a Master’s degree in Computer Science. If the student does not already have an MS in CS, they may be admitted into the MS/Ph.D. program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Computational Mathematics option (6 courses in CS and math) sits inside this PhD.
